motion.2: She waves at the camera with a friendly smile, then rests a hand on her hip and sways gently from side to side, hair moving softly, always in motion.
motion.3: She winks at the camera and flips her hair playfully, shifting her weight from foot to foot and swaying as if to a song, always in motion.
motion.4: She slowly turns in place, looks back over her shoulder at the camera with a teasing smile, then turns to face front again, hair swaying.
motion.5: She dances playfully to an upbeat song, hips swaying, arms moving, smiling at the camera, constantly in motion.
motion.6: She sways slowly to a slow song with her hands on her hips, half-lidded eyes on the camera and a slow flirty smile, hips never still.
motion.7: She dances with a slow spin, arms raised, then settles into a pose with a sultry gaze at the camera, lips slightly parted, still swaying.
motion.8: She takes a slow step toward the camera, bites her lower lip and runs a hand from her collarbone down her side, swaying to a slow beat.
motion.9: She runs both hands through her hair while swaying slowly, sultry gaze at the camera, lips parted, and the camera drifts slowly closer.
motion.10: She dances a slow seductive dance, hips rolling, hands sliding along her sides, sultry half-lidded gaze locked on the camera, the camera drifting slowly.
